_about: Health watch thresholds (ROADMAP L12, launch checklist LC-17). This file is the only copy: docs/ops/launch-checklist.md section 3 and docs/ops/runbooks/health-watch.md link here. A key ending in _max alerts when the value is above it, _min when below it. Keys starting with _ are comments. scripts/health-watch.py refuses unknown keys.
_deadline: One budget for a whole run (all checks); checks not done when it runs out alert as 'deadline'. Notify commands get 2 x notify.command_timeout_s on top. The systemd unit's TimeoutStartSec must stay above both (a test checks).

require._about: A target that is not configured (no --node / --rpc / --site and no ONYX_WATCH_* variable) alerts when required, else prints skip lines. The site turns required once a public build is published (LC-6).

addresses._source: docs/ops/deployment.md 'Deployed addresses (Base Sepolia)' (the NS17 run of 2026-10-27). Public addresses only, never a key; health-watch-tests.py checks they match that table. null skips the check, with a skip line.

node._indexer_lag: Blocks, not seconds: Base Sepolia made a block every 0.2 s on 2026-10-27 (10,000 blocks in 2,000 s, measured by hand; it was 2 s on 2026-10-15). 10,000 blocks is about 33 min, the time the old 1,000 at 2 s meant, and above one finality step (about 5,000 blocks, see rpc._about) so a fresh step on the watch's RPC alone never alerts.
node._indexer_ahead: The cursor may run past the finalized head the watch sees by at most this (ONYX_INDEX_MAX_JUMP's default, and two providers' heads differ a little); more is a lying node or a state file from another chain.
node._intents_open_for: validBefore is at most now + maxTimeoutSeconds (60) + 300 s; the resolver drops an unused intent past validBefore + 600 s (deployment.md 'What runs'). /v1/health has no intent ages, so this is how long intentsOpen may stay above 0 without a break.
node._clock_skew: payments are refused (503 clock_skew) above 300 s
node._level3: ROADMAP C62, THREATS C10-3: /v1/health level3 (crates/onyx-api/src/signed_serve.rs fn health_of). onyx-node stops every level-3 answer once a post has been pending more than 600 s (its own clock); the watch alerts at 300 s, five 60 s runs before the breaker (health-watch.py refuses more than 385 s: a 90 s deadline_s run, the timer's 60 s and 5 s accuracy, then one more run; review C61-R2-1). Not required until a level-3 store runs (C10 deploy and C60 are open). A refused post is the book deciding (Replay, Stale, BadSignature...): each new one (postsRefusedFinal) alerts once; one that may clear (FromFuture, UnknownKey, KeySuspended) is retried and holds its fact, so it alerts after 3 runs.

rpc._about: The chain node (JSON-RPC). The limits are in blocks, so they follow the block time. sepolia.base.org's finalized head ran 500 to 1,004 blocks behind latest on 2026-10-15/16 at 2 s blocks (17 to 33 min; a sawtooth: batches post, then L1 finalizes them). On 2026-10-27 blocks came every 0.2 s (10,000 blocks in 2,000 s) and the lag was 5,074 blocks (17 min), so the old 3,600-block limit alerted on normal batching (THREATS NL5-2). The limit, 36,000 blocks, is 2 h at 0.2 s, over 3x the largest lag measured in time; past it finality has stalled and the indexer, which reads only finalized blocks, stops seeing new roots.

balances._about: Deployer gas (the A2 run used 0.000262 ETH; 0.001 ETH is about 4 runs) and OnyxRevenue's invariant USDC.balanceOf(revenue) >= allocated() - paidOut().
balances._operator: ROADMAP L19, THREATS NS17-4: the API operator's gas for self-settles and receipt posts. The NS17 run of 2026-10-27 spent 0.000211 ETH on 145 transactions (about 0.0000015 ETH each), so 0.00002 ETH is about 13 sends: enough lead time to top it up from the deployer. Skipped while the node reports payments off.

site._about: The public website: GET <site>/ and <site>/data/demo.json, which must be a public build (public: true, every runs[].input null).

after._about: Consecutive failed runs before a check alerts (default 1); earlier runs print status warn. The checklist asks node up: alert after 3 failures.

notify._about: A check that stays in alert is sent again after realert_after_s; a recovery is sent once.
